name: Dense Shade
description: Pack a bead of darkness so tightly into the fist that the blow lands with the weight of a thrown stone.

name: Leaden Cloak
description: Settle a heavy cloak of dark qi on the shoulders that steadies the stance and lends weight to each blow.

name: Weighted Guard
description: Sink the stance and let dense darkness at the forearms take a heavy blow without giving ground.

name: Press Step
description: Advance a pace with the whole weight set down on the lead foot as a dark mass settles.

name: Sinking Murk
description: Pin a foe's weapon arm under a palm of thick murk until the grip loosens.

name: Crushing Gloom
description: Drive a dark palm through a raised guard and let the packed gloom burst inside the arm.

name: Settled Dark
description: Stand in a planted guard with dense darkness held at the chest and arms through a long exchange.

name: Anchor Shadow
description: Drop a shadow as heavy as an anchor on the foe's feet and hold them to the ground.

name: Leaden Pall
description: Bring down a fist wrapped in packed darkness with the full weight of the body to split a shield rim or a plank.

name: Sinking Gloom
description: Press dense dark into the ground so it rolls outward beneath nearby foes and drags them down onto their knees.

name: Umbra Seed
description: Plant a seed of dark qi in the air about the body to grow into a field in the next breath.

name: Lightless Palm
description: Strike with a palm that gives off no glow so the foe cannot judge its reach or its speed.

name: Lightless Guard
description: Thicken the dark about the chest into a close field that stops a thrust before it reaches the skin.

name: Umbra Sense
description: Let the field carry the touch of every body that brushes its edge back to the user.

name: Umbra Spread
description: Spread the field outward over several paces so that any light inside it dims and the foe's eyes tire.

name: Swallowing Edge
description: Cut with the blade of the hand along the rim of the field so the blow arrives out of the dark.

name: Umbra Shroud
description: Wrap the whole body in the field and hold it as a shroud that turns aside light blows and sight.

name: Devouring Umbra
description: Draw the field tight round every foe inside it and eat the light and strength out of the air they breathe.

name: Sensing Dark
description: Open the field wide and read the number and the stance and the intent of everyone within its edge.

name: Dusk Call
description: Call a small patch of dusk down round the body so the next steps pass among the grey unseen.

name: Gathered Cut
description: Cut across with the edge of the hand through the gathered dusk so the blow hardly shows.

name: Dusk Mantle
description: Throw the dusk over the shoulders as a mantle that dulls a blow and hides which arm moves.

name: Dusk Drift
description: Drift on the grey air to a spot three paces off while the foe still guards the old one.

name: Haze Cast
description: Cast a haze of dusk into the face of one foe so friend and stranger look alike.

name: Grey Eyes
description: See by the dusk alone and learn which shapes in the grey carry weapons and which carry only cloth.

name: Dusk Fall
description: Let a curtain of dusk fall over the foes in front so each of them blinks and loses the line.

name: Dusk Blend
description: Blend the outlines of the foes together in the dusk until they cannot pick out a target.

name: Dusk Ward
description: Hold a ward of thick dusk before the allies at the user's side and turn blows into the grey.

name: Descending Dusk
description: Call the dusk down in a heavy pour over a wide ground until the foes strike at their own side.

name: Dusk Dissolve
description: Let the dusk eat at the steadiness of a foe's stance and the line of his qi until both come apart.

name: Twin Gloam
description: Strike with both palms together from two angles each wrapped in a thin gloom.

name: Paired Shade
description: Raise two patches of shade at once to meet a blow from the left and from the right.

name: Twin Stride
description: Take two strides in quick time with a dim afterimage following the first.

name: Dual Dim
description: Dim the light on both sides of one foe so he looks from one dark to the other and finds neither.

name: Closing Pair
description: Send two walls of dim qi in from opposite sides that meet in the middle on whatever stands there.

name: Twin Veil
description: Hang two veils of dark one behind the other so the second catches what the first lets through.

name: Twin Eclipse
description: Bring two black discs in over a ring of foes from either side and close them into one eclipse.

name: Twin Bind
description: Cast one black cord from each hand and draw them across the foe until arms and legs are held.

name: Shadow Talon
description: Hook the fingers like a hawk's talon and rake across the face with a claw of shadow.

name: Rising Shade
description: Spring up on a lift of cool shade and land a pace behind the foe's shoulder.

name: Soaring Cloak
description: Spread a wide cloak of shadow from the arms like pinions that quickens the next movements.

name: Feather Guard
description: Brush a cut aside with a forearm trailing dark feathers that carry the edge off line.

name: Keen Gaze
description: Fix the gaze on the ground ahead and let dark qi sharpen it to pick out small movements.

name: Stooping Shadow
description: Drop from a raised position with a heavy shadow trailing and land a blow on the crown of the foe.

name: Talon Snare
description: Loose a claw of shadow that closes on an ankle or wrist and holds it a breath.

name: Wing Shadow
description: Hold a wing of shadow over the side and back that turns arrows and blades from above.

name: Hawk Fall
description: Fall onto the foe from above with the shadow of the whole body stooping first as a dark warning.

name: Overcast Wing
description: Sweep a vast wing of shadow overhead that dims the sky above the foes and covers the user.

name: Duet Palm
description: Push the strike court palm forward in a firm blow while the other hand stays back for the guard.

name: Duet Shield
description: Hold the guard court hand before the chest and thicken the dark in it to stop a thrust.

name: Duet Stride
description: Move between the two courts of dark with a step that keeps the body between strike and guard.

name: Duet Glance
description: Glance from one court to the other and read what the foe does in the gap between them.

name: Strike Duo
description: Gather the whole strike court of dark into one hand and release it in a hard blow.

name: Guard Duo
description: Gather the guard court into a wall of dark held steady at the front of the body.

name: Joined Duo
description: Join the two courts so that each blow charges the guard and each guard charges the blow.

name: Double Dark
description: Strike and guard in one motion with both courts open so the foe meets a wall that hits back.

name: Duet Judgment
description: Pass the weight of both courts onto one foe and hold it until his strength gives way.

name: Breath Shade
description: Breathe out a thin shade that clings to the body and blurs its edge against the dim.

name: Draught Step
description: Step with the draught at the back and carry the body a long pace on a breath of shade.

name: Breath Cut
description: Cut with the edge of the hand on the out-breath so shade and wind both lend weight.

name: Bent Shade
description: Bend the shade about a forearm and turn a blow aside along the curve of the wind.

name: Gust Feeler
description: Feel the draught for the way it shades round people and read their numbers and their pace.

name: Whisper Dim
description: Breathe a whisper of dim across one foe's face so his eyes lose the edge of what he fights.

name: Bending Shade
description: Bend the shade across a stretch of ground so that distances look wrong to everyone in it.

name: Veer Strike
description: Swing a strike that veers on a gust of shade at the last instant to enter the guard from the side.

name: Breath Cloak
description: Hold a cloak of breathing shade about the body that thickens on every blow it meets.

name: Stilled Air
description: Draw the wind out from round a foe and fill the space with still dark that slows him.

name: Sworn Shade
description: Loose every sworn breath of shade into a single straight blow that does not stop for a guard.

name: Carried Dark
description: Carry a bank of dark on the wind over a wide ground and let it settle all at once on the foes.

name: Sable Heading
description: Hold a set heading of dark qi through the body so each move follows one clear line.

name: Unlit Palm
description: Push a palm forward along the held heading with a dark edge that cannot be seen coming.

name: Rooted Shade
description: Plant the stance on the heading and take a blow on a shield of dark that does not shift.

name: Steady Step
description: Step along the line of the heading without wavering whatever the foe throws across it.

name: Heading Feel
description: Take a sounding of the dark ahead along the heading and learn what stands on it.

name: Oath Dark
description: Swear the dark to the foe's feet and press until his weight sinks and he cannot rise.

name: Sable Screen
description: Hold a long line of dark across the front that no foe can cross without paying for it.

name: Bearing Cut
description: Cut along the heading with a blade of dark that finishes where the line ends.

name: Sworn Release
description: Loose all the held dark along the heading at once in a wide burst that sweeps the line clear.

name: Unwavering Dark
description: Stand on the heading and hold a deep shield of dark that does not thin however long the strikes.

name: Open Dark
description: Throw a ball of dark plainly along a clear line so the foe can only meet it or flee.

name: Thrown Shade
description: Hurl a flat sheet of shade across a short gap to strike the chest with a slap of cold.

name: Broad Step
description: Cover a wide stretch of ground in one open stride with no cover but the dim.

name: Wide Sense
description: Open the dark qi wide and feel everything that moves across the open ground ahead.

name: Open Sweep
description: Sweep an arm in a broad arc and send dark across the whole front in a flat wave.

name: Bare Pall
description: Draw a bare pall of dark across the foes so they can see no landmark and find no cover.

name: Unsheltered
description: Strip the shadows from round a foe and bear down on him in an open and hostile dark.

name: Exposing Dark
description: Send a wave of dark that pulls every concealment off those it crosses and leaves them bare.

name: Open Crush
description: Bring the whole dark down on one point in plain sight and let the weight do the work.
